summary: Built 1935 on the Yakama Reservation; its 68-ft tower and house moved to Signal Peak in 1964, where the register describes the current tower; original site needs permission.

facts.status_note: Tower and house moved to Signal Peak in 1964; the original site is described only by footings visible from the air

notes_for_editor: The move to Signal Peak is corroborated by four sources plus the NHLR. Signal Peak's current condition rests on the NHLR entry and a June 2019 trip report; no current source was checked. A Firelookout.com Signal Peak page surfaced only as a search snippet and was not read or cited.
